items.title: Dick Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 1, 2006
items.q: my favorite drummers were George Wettling with Condon, Buzzy Drootin and the great Cliff Leeman. Those were my idols.

ctx.x: And after about three or four lessons Tony said, “You can keep time, I’m not going to take your money anymore.” He said, “Just travel light, keep your ears open, and you’ll do fine.” So that was my first teacher, it wasn’t very technically advanced. But then my favorite drummers were George Wettling with Condon, Buzzy Drootin and the great Cliff Leeman. Those were my idols. Keeping time, keeping time.
